band_method: point estimate uses fn_bounded_mortgage_rate(estimated_rate); lower/upper recompute fn_estimated_upb at the canonical 1%-15% plausible rate bounds and include the point estimate
rounding: banker's rounding to the nearest dollar, matching Databricks BROUND

cases.note: Ordinary positive-rate row: the 6% point estimate falls inside the 1%-15% rate band.
Unknown rate uses straight-line point estimate; band expands to include that fallback and the 15% plausible-rate upper.
Source high-rate outlier clamps to the canonical 15% ceiling for the point estimate.
Source low-rate value below 1% is treated as missing, so the point estimate uses the linear fallback.
Elapsed months beyond term collapse both point estimate and band to zero.
Missing original UPB cannot be amortized and must fail closed.
